body: `// getAxisMask() and getButtonMask() were taken from SDL source code to make joypad GUIDs compatible with SDL`
What's the license for the SDL source code?
In the comment, can you elaborate on why it's desirable to make joypad GUIDs compatible with SDL controller mappings.
Add a comment to describe what axes 2, 4, and 6 represent.

It's zlib. https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/blob/main/LICENSE.txt
And we have it mentioned in our COPYRIGHT.txt file here:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8ae5300319f14f8253c8158b846f355b/COPYRIGHT.txt#L562-L565
Those two can be constants and the method itself can be made static.
Why is it gated by version 19?

In SDL's source code, `getVendorId` and `getProductId` are only used with API 19 and above: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/blob/ec1d66d4f693b367ff60f01eac74406b3615fbed/android-project/app/src/main/java/org/libsdl/app/SDLControllerManager.java#L347-L357

And according to Android docs, that's the version that introduced these methods: https://developer.android.com/about/versions/kitkat/android-4.4#Controllers

```suggestion
		if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.KITKAT) { // InputDevice#getVendorId() and InputDevice#getProductId() are only present in API 19 and above.
```
In the update above the `button_mask` and `axis_mask` were defaulted to `-1`; is there a difference with using `0` here?
Here and in the updates below, parameters and variables names should use the `camelCase` style. `snake_case` is only used in the C++ codebase.
They aren't used when a device gets disconnected
Our minimum API level is 24, so a check for API 19 is not needed. We should remove this check and the else block below.
This check should probably be inside `input_handler->generate_joy_guid`

If `050000005e040000130b0000ffff3f00` is present in both internal SDL and SDL_GameControllerDB, then it might be a bug that it's in SDL_GameControllerDB and it should likely be removed.

It seems like it was added in SDL_GameControllerDB in 2020 with https://github.com/mdqinc/SDL_GameControllerDB/commit/d1f0e1e798b6aac86c424fa999c985be9db72a6d, and later to SDL itself in 2021 with https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/commit/afd100f02b7689e3b1cf441f7abf40f0313f328b.

They're not too keen on receiving PRs from Godot contributors (understandably, as for several years we had our own non-SDL implementation and misunderstood the scope of that repo, and sent custom mappings that Godot needed but SDL itself didn't need). But I'll open an issue about it as I believe it's not a Godot specific issue, just one we happened to discover.

*Edit:* Done: https://github.com/mdqinc/SDL_GameControllerDB/issues/913.

For Godot, we can override the invalid `gamecontrollerdb.txt` mapping with the latest SDL one in `godotcontrollerdb.txt`, until we switch to proper SDL on Android too, in which case the solution can be to instead remove the mapping from both `gamecontrollerdb.txt` and `godotcontrollerdb.txt`.
